title: Siemens Software Center: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 23 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Business software
category.why: It runs day-to-day business work such as finance, printing, phones or manufacturing.
category.doThis: Ask the vendor or the team that owns it whether the fix is in.

summary: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Nov 3, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
